# Architecture Options

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos reveals many possible vessels; the chosen vessel must preserve the newest reader while letting Awtsmoos.com speak clearly before JavaScript arrives.

## Option A — Nested template include

Keep `$a("initial-content.html")` inside the shell. Rejected because fresh-server evidence already showed empty nested output and path ownership is route-relative.

## Option B — Restore the old shell wholesale

Rejected because it would discard the newer `reader-calm-001` mobile stylesheet and reader integration work.

## Option C — Route-layer pre-rendered fragments

Chosen. `postReader.js` already owns resolved post data and successfully renders `semantic-head.html`. It will also render `initial-content.html` and a modular `reader-settings.html`, then pass finished strings to the current calm/mobile shell.

## Option D — Build HTML entirely in JavaScript

Rejected because it duplicates the shell, weakens template ownership, and would produce a larger route module.

## Option E — Client prerender snapshot

Rejected because the user explicitly wants Google-visible content even when JavaScript is not the source of truth.
